answer: Every claim climbs the echo of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the mirror is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
